title: Oh let the son of God enfold you

lines.text: Oh let the Son of God enfold you
With His Spirit and His Life,
Let Him fill your heart and satisfy your soul,
Oh let Him have the things that hold you,
And His Spirit like a dove
Will descend upon your life and make you whole.
Oh come and sing this song of gladness
As your hearts are filled with joy,
Lift your hands in sweet surrender to His Name.
Oh give Him all your tears and sadness,
Give all your guilt and pain and
Youll enter into life in Jesus Name.
